sections.title: Habitats
lines: Fresh water and salt water (aquatic summoning tables, p. 378)

sections.title: Appearance
lines: A deep-bodied fish with tight scales and triangular cutting teeth. The portrait uses a silver flank and copper-red throat. The book describes the school’s behavior.

sections.title: Combat mechanics
lines: Bite · A bite deals 1–2 damage.
Approaching the school · When a creature swims or wades near the school, there is a 75% chance that at least one piranha attacks.
Feeding frenzy · If the piranhas attack and draw blood, the whole school frenzies. Each piranha attacks twice per melee round.
School attack limit · Up to 20 piranhas can attack one man-sized target simultaneously.

sections.title: Table notes
lines: 5–50 appearing. Unsteady (6) morale.
Fresh Water I and Salt Water I each summon 3d4 piranhas on p. 378. Roll the Fish table’s 5–50 for a natural school.
Monstrous Manual, TSR 2140, January 1994 third printing, Fish pp. 117–118.

sections.title: Habitats
lines: Fresh water (aquatic summoning table, p. 378)

sections.title: Appearance
lines: A deep-bodied piranha with a heavy jaw and forked tail. The portrait shows the rising posture of a sky-eater. The book describes its leap rather than a specific color or length.

sections.title: Combat mechanics
lines: Bite · A bite deals 1–6 damage.
Approaching the school · When a creature swims or wades near the school, there is a 75% chance that at least one piranha attacks.
Feeding frenzy · If the piranhas attack and draw blood, the whole school frenzies. Each piranha attacks twice per melee round.
School attack limit · Up to 10 giant piranhas can attack one man-sized target simultaneously.
Sky-eater leap · Once per round, a giant piranha can charge at full speed and leap up to 10 feet above the water. It often strikes at low-flying waterfowl and sometimes at people.

sections.title: Table notes
lines: 2–20 appearing. Average (10) morale.
The Giant Piranha shares the ordinary school’s attack behavior. Use its own number appearing and simultaneous attack limit.
Giant Piranha appears in Fresh Water II on p. 378.
Monstrous Manual, TSR 2140, January 1994 third printing, Fish pp. 117–118.
